# Loop

Where these methods are:

- `session.loop` — `Session.loop`, a `SessionLoop`

Every method here is generated from igni-core's RPC contract; its documentation is igni's own. The examples run inside an `async` function with `igni` an open `IgniClient` and `session` one of its sessions ([Quick start](/docs/sdk/igni-client/quick-start)).

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`session.loop.cancel()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/loop#session-loop-cancel) | End this session's running `/loop`. |
| [`session.loop.next_iteration()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/loop#session-loop-next-iteration) | Take the next step of this session's `/loop`, for the client to send. |
| [`session.loop.pause()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/loop#session-loop-pause) | Pause this session's `/loop` after the current iteration. |
| [`session.loop.resume()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/loop#session-loop-resume) | Resume this session's paused `/loop`. |
| [`session.loop.status()`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/loop#session-loop-status) | Read the state of this session's `/loop`. |

## session.loop.cancel()

End this session's running `/loop`.

```python
async def cancel(self) -> bool
```

Takes no arguments. Returns `true` when a loop was ended;
`false` when there was none or it is paused (a paused loop is
resumed or left alone, not cancelled).

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `bool`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `cancel_pending_loop`, scope `session`, area `loop`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
cancelled = await session.loop.cancel()
print("cancelled" if cancelled else "no loop waiting")
```

## session.loop.next_iteration()

Take the next step of this session's `/loop`, for the client to send.

```python
async def next_iteration(self) -> LoopAdvance | None
```

Takes no arguments. Returns `null` when there is no loop or it is
paused. Otherwise `kind` says what happened: `step` carries the
`prompt` to send as the next message (and `display_prompt` to
show), the iteration number and how many remain; `completed`
says the loop reached its cap and ended; `safety_paused` says it
reached the hard cap and paused.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** [`LoopAdvance`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#loopadvance)` | None`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `pop_pending_loop_iteration`, scope `session`, area `loop`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
advance = await session.loop.next_iteration()
if advance is not None:
    print(advance.iteration, advance.prompt)
```

## session.loop.pause()

Pause this session's `/loop` after the current iteration.

```python
async def pause(self) -> bool
```

Takes no arguments. Returns `true` when the loop is now paused
(or already was), `false` when there is no loop.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `bool`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `loop_pause`, scope `session`, area `loop`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
paused = await session.loop.pause()
print("paused" if paused else "no loop to pause")
```

## session.loop.resume()

Resume this session's paused `/loop`.

```python
async def resume(self) -> str
```

Takes no arguments. Returns the prompt of the iteration to run next,
for the client to send as a message — nothing runs on its own — or
`""` when there is no paused loop.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** `str`.

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `loop_resume`, scope `session`, area `loop`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
answer = await session.loop.resume()
print(answer)
```

## session.loop.status()

Read the state of this session's `/loop`.

```python
async def status(self) -> LoopStatusSnapshot
```

Takes no arguments. Returns whether a loop is `active` and
`paused`, its prompt, which iteration it is on and how many
remain, whether its cap was set explicitly, and the total the agent
announced, if any.

Takes no arguments.

**Returns** [`LoopStatusSnapshot`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/models-reference#loopstatussnapshot).

**Access** [`client`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/access) — any connection igni admitted.

**Raises** [`InvalidArguments`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#invalidarguments) · [`MethodFailed`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#methodfailed) · [`UnknownMethod`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unknownmethod) · [`UnexpectedAnswer`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unexpectedanswer) · [`Unavailable`](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference#unavailable) ([when each is raised](/docs/sdk/igni-client/errors-reference))

**On the wire** RPC method `loop_status`, scope `session`, area `loop`; igni answers with `rpc_response`.

**Example**

```python
status = await session.loop.status()
print(status.active, status.announced_total)
```
